name: It's a Plan
description: Runs a self-hosted issue tracker where AI agents take issues as teammates, with a REST API, MCP server, webhooks and a runner for Claude Code and Codex. For teams sharing work with agents.

skills.name: Agents as teammates
skills.description: Adds agents as project members with roles, permissions and assigned issues on the shared board.

skills.name: External agent runner
skills.description: Hands each task to Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, opencode or any stdin command on your machine.

skills.name: Triggered runs
skills.description: Starts an agent run on an @mention, an assignment, or a schedule.

skills.name: Pull request linking
skills.description: Links pull requests from GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, Forgejo and Bitbucket and moves the issue as they open and merge.

skills.name: Outgoing webhooks
skills.description: Sends signed event payloads with retries and a delivery log.
